conflictPairs.text: Main p.2 says PVP-H does not produce well-defined nanoparticles even at low injection rates while the explicit PVP-H protocol produces defined nanorods. We interpret the comparison narrowly as failure to produce the AgNH-type particles, not as a negation of the rod result.

Main p.7 states 2–3 weeks of open-air Ag rod exposure; SI Figure S2 reports the pictured Ag2S nanotube after 3 weeks. The SI caption explicitly says panel a Ag rod and panel b nanotube are typical different objects.
Main Figure 1b artwork labels the zone axis [0 1 1̅], whereas its caption on PDF p.1 and prose on p.4 give [0 0 1̅]. Preserve both source statements; do not silently repair the index.

general_background.title: A reaction medium with chemical roles
general_background.summary: A polyol medium can participate in precursor coordination as well as transporting heat and dissolved species. Whether it also acts as a reductant depends on the reactants and reaction conditions.
general_background.label: General background, not the authors' interpretation

general_background.title: From a metal precursor to reactive species
general_background.summary: A metal precursor supplies the metal, while its ligands and conversion chemistry influence how reactive species become available. Stronger or more persistent coordination can slow release of reactive metal species, while ligand exchange can open alternative conversion pathways.
general_background.label: General background, not the authors' interpretation
